deleteAll.title: Delete all your data?
deleteAll.historyIntro: This permanently erases everything we've saved for this browser:
deleteAll.historyOutro: Your cookie choice stays, so we won't ask again. This can't be undone.
deleteAll.guestDescription: History is off, so we aren't saving anything right now. If you saved photos in this browser before, this permanently erases them.
deleteAll.error: We couldn't delete your data. Nothing was removed, so it's safe to try again.

historyRevoke.title: Turn off history?
historyRevoke.description: Turning off history erases everything we've saved for this browser — all your photos, verdicts and your history session. This can't be undone.
historyRevoke.error: We couldn't erase your data, so history is still on. Try again.

notices.allDataErased: All gone. Your photos and verdicts were deleted.
notices.guestDataErased: Done. Nothing saved in this browser remains.
notices.historyRevoked: History is off and your data was erased.
notices.historyEnabled: History is on. New checks will be saved here.
